name: Tariq Al-Khathami
headline: Project Lead & Researcher at Saudi Aramco R&D Center | Inventor | Chemical & Process Engineer
summary: Tariq Al-Khathami is an engineer, project leader, and recognized inventor working at the Saudi Aramco Research & Development Center. He leads advanced innovation initiatives focused on artificial intelligence, robotics, and industrial process optimization in the energy sector. His work integrates engineering, AI systems, and chemical process technologies to develop next-generation solutions for energy infrastructure and industrial operations.

current_roles.title: Technical Lead — Heavy Oil Upgrading & Advanced Materials
current_roles.description: Technical lead for a new R&D effort on catalytic upgrading of heavy oil residue into higher-value products and advanced materials.

current_roles.title: Project Lead — AI Optimizer for Refinery PFDs
current_roles.organization: Saudi Aramco Research & Development Center (Fuels & Chemicals)
current_roles.description: Leading the development of an AI-based system that generates Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) for the energy sector, translating a patented algorithm into an operational tool for engineering design and decision-making.

previous_roles.title: Project Lead — AI & Robotics in Chemical Processing
previous_roles.description: Led development of the Online Deposition Removal System (ODRS) to combat solid deposition in chemical processing, advancing the project through Stage 2 and securing 10 patents to protect its intellectual property.

previous_roles.title: Technical Lead — Predictive Modeling for Process Scaling
previous_roles.description: Technical lead for a patent-derived project developing a predictive model for scale and deposit formation in process equipment.
